content.short: Chipper Cash is an African fintech app for free cross-border transfers, cards, stocks and crypto.
content.description: Chipper Cash is a fintech platform used by millions of Africans to send money across borders for free, pay with cards and invest in US stocks and crypto. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Chipper Cash among its payments partners.
content.meta: Chipper Cash is an African money app for free cross-border transfers and crypto, listed on Stable.
